title: Prime-square-sum Hamiltonian cycles
words: Arrange 1 to N in a circle so every two neighbours sum to the square of a prime. Show this is possible for all large even N.
math: Let $G_N$ join $a\ne b\in[N]$ when $a+b=p^2$ for a prime $p$. Prove $G_N$ is Hamiltonian for all sufficiently large even $N$.

title: Spectre drum eigenvalue is transcendental
words: Show the lowest frequency of a drum shaped like the curved spectre tile is transcendental.
math: Prove the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of the spectre domain is transcendental.

title: Square-sum triangle-free density
words: Find the largest fraction of 1 to N you can keep with no three numbers whose pairwise sums are all perfect squares.
math: Determine $\lim_{N}\frac1N\max\{|A|:A\subseteq[N],\ A\text{ contains no triangle of }S_N\}$.

title: Is eventual periodicity of square-plus-one decidable?
words: Is there an algorithm that decides, for any n, whether its square-plus-one sequence eventually loops?
math: Decide whether $\{n: (Q^k(n))_k \text{ is eventually periodic}\}$ is recursive, where $Q(n)=P(n^2+1)$.

title: Seven-free primes with a large shifted factor
words: Show a positive fraction of seven-free primes p have p − 1 with a prime factor bigger than p^0.6.

title: Codes with prime distances
words: Find the largest set of binary strings of length n in which every two differ in a prime number of positions.
math: Determine the asymptotic maximum of $|C|$ over $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$ with $d_H(x,y)$ prime for all distinct $x,y\in C$.
